author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: SQUARE: round r18 cranium (two cardinal quarter arcs), short side walls, cheeks curving in to jaw verticals at x=12/36 down to the bottom edge, two long teeth between them, r3 ring eyes 8 from the walls. Follows the reference outline: round cranium, stepped jaw, two teeth.
omissions: Eyes limited to r3 rings (r4 would need a cranium half-width of 20; SQUARE allows 18).
